headline: Special permit to divide 675 Andover Street into two lots; car wash at 585 Pawtucket Boulevard; 205-unit development at 41 Hurd Street.
summary: This agenda covers a special permit to divide 675 Andover Street into two residential lots. It also covers site plan review and a special permit for a car wash at 585 Pawtucket Boulevard, and site plan review for a 205-unit mixed-use development at 41 Hurd Street.

City of Lowell - Planning Board 
 
Planning Board Agenda 
November 2, 2026 at 6:30 PM 
 
Meetings will be held in the City Council Chambers at 375 Merrimack 
Street, Lowell MA 01852 or via remote participation as permitted by An Act Extending 
Certain COVID-19 Measures Adopted During the State of Emergency signed by Governor 
Healey on 3/28/2025. 
 
The public is welcome and can participate remotely as follows:  
 
Members of the public may view the meeting via ltc.org or local cable channel 6. Those 
wishing to speak regarding a specific agenda item shall register to speak in advance of the 
meeting by sending an email to dricker@lowellma.gov,  pcutrumbes@lowellma.gov AND 
mbrundage@lowellma.gov indicating the agenda item and a phone number to call so that 
you may be issued a Z oom link to the meeting. If no access to email, you may contact 
Development Services at 978 -674-4144. All requests must occur prior to 4:00PM on the 
day of meeting.  
 
For help with zoom please visit: Joining a Zoom meeting – Zoom Support 
        
Review all application documents online at: www.lowellma.gov/1098/Planning-Board 
 
I. Minutes for Approval 
 
10/19/2026 Meeting Minutes 
 
II. Continued Business 
 
 Special Permit - 675 Andover Street, 01852  
Debbie M. and Kevin Fernandes have applied to the Lowell Planning Board seeking a Special Permit 
to divide the property into two residential lots at 675 Andover Street. The subject property is in the 
Suburban Single Family (SSF) zoning district. The proposal requires a Special Permit per Section 
5.1.1 for frontage reduction and per Section 5.2.9 for large SSF lots with reduced frontage.  
 
III. New Business 
 
Site Plan Review and Special Permit – 585 Pawtucket Boulevard, 01854 
Aim Realty Medford, LLC has applied to the Lowell Planning Board for Site Plan Review and Special 
Permit approval to operate a car wash at 585 Pawtucket Boulevard. The subject property is in the 
Suburban Mixed Use (SMU) zoning district. The application requires Site Plan Review approval under 
Section 11.4.2(2) for any commercial construction involving the installation or construction of self-
service gasoline pumps or drive-through or drive-up customer service on the premises and a Special 
Permit pursuant to Section 11.3.1 and Article 12.6 (f) for a car washing establishment. 
 
Site Plan Review – 41 Hurd Street, 01852 
New England Heritage Properties, Inc. has applied to the Lowell Planning Board for Site Plan Review 
approval to construct a 205-unit mixed-use development at 41 Hurd Street. The subject property is 
located in the Downtown Mixed-Use (DMU) zoning district and Multi-Family Overlay – Mid Rise 
(MFOM) Overlay District. The project requires Site Plan Review approval from the Lowell Planning 
Board per Section 11.4 for a development with greater than 3 residential units, and a parking area 
with greater than 14 parking spaces.
